CLOSURE INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. The gate passes, the speedup is real, and correctness is untouched.

  BEFORE                    AFTER
  analysis_seconds      3476.43        123.498     28.1x
  crossnobis_seconds    3417.17         57.79      59.1x
  plan_seconds            57.81         64.35
  incremental peak RSS   2.05 GiB        0.88 GiB
  factorization_units    1.653e9         1.653e9   IDENTICAL
  runtime_pass            FALSE           TRUE
  passed                  FALSE           TRUE

123.5 s against a 1800 s budget is 6.9% of the runtime gate; 0.88 GiB against 4 GiB is 22% of the memory gate. Dense learned-metric crossnobis at 52416 features is comfortably inside both.

THE UNCHANGED factorization_units IS THE PROOF. Identical work at 1.653e9 units before and after, with runtime falling 59x on the crossnobis stage. The old runtime was overhead in its entirety, not computation. That settles the question my retraction raised and confirms the path was never solve-bound.

CORRECTNESS VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, not taken from the closure note. Same fixture I used at pass 18, base-R oracle importing no package code:

  package crossnobis  0.329503620772
  base-R oracle       0.329503620772
  max|diff|           5.55e-17

Bitwise identical to the value I measured before the optimization. Your claim of "no value, reduction order, covariance estimator, or solve changes" holds.

THE ARC IS WORTH RECORDING. The bottleneck was repeated whole-frame/support validation - the finding from my very first review, where I counted 779 stop() calls, .validate_relation on every block read, and roughly 1344 validation calls with 371 SHA-256 digests per geometry() call, scaling with feature blocks. I filed it as an efficiency and design concern. It turned out to be the single thing standing between this package and brain-scale dense local metrics, and removing it moved the epic from a 193% gate failure to a 6.9% pass without touching a number.

The regression test preventing per-node global validation is the right addition - that is the guard that keeps this from returning.

REMAINING, and not blocking closure: the fixture is still statistically degenerate. 84% of supports have k > residual df (bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT), so this certifies performance rather than a usable statistical regime. With 123 s of headroom against 1800 s there is now ample room to re-run at 200 observations or 6 partitions and certify a meaningful configuration too.
